summary: Configured and verified peer-limited, key-based SSH for `clusterops` across node1, node2, and node3. All six directed connections pass non-interactively by stable node name.
actions_performed: Created locked non-root `clusterops` accounts with distinct node-local Ed25519 identities.
Added stable node-name mappings and exactly two IP-scoped, restricted peer authorizations per node.
Required public-key authentication; disabled passwords, PTYs, forwarding, and tunneling for `clusterops`.
Pinned peer Ed25519 host keys and disabled automatic host-key expansion.
Installed identical topology, verification, and recovery documentation on all nodes at `/usr/local/share/doc/ssh-cluster/OPERATIONS.md`.
Verified unauthorized and non-key authentication attempts are rejected.

evidence.summary: Final audits passed on all nodes: UID 1000, locked password, valid sshd configuration, active SSH service/socket, secure file modes, and effective public-key-only authentication.

evidence.requirement: Every node reaches both peers non-interactively by stable name
evidence.summary: All six directed paths returned the requested remote hostname and `clusterops` user; targets observed the correct source-node IP.
Each node has exactly two `from="peer-IP",restrict` authorized keys. Every server rejected both a no-public-key attempt and an unapproved temporary key.
Each client retains exactly two directly pinned peer Ed25519 host keys, restricts host-key algorithms to Ed25519, and disables automatic host-key updates.
All nodes contain the root-owned mode-0644 operations guide with identical SHA-256, complete topology rows, basic verification, and recovery procedures.
